title: Jack Got Me Good — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal absurdist English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Joel rang Mum from the hospital bed
Said Jack drove the buggy right into my leg
Mum said — Joel, that is not how you drive
Joel said — Mum, I wasn't driving, I was just alive

[Verse 2 — Español]
Mum dijo — Joel, ¿estás bien del todo? [Mum said — Joel, are you completely alright?]
Joel dijo — solo el tobillo y la pierna con un hoyo [Joel said — just the ankle and leg with a hole]
Ella dijo — ¿dónde estaba Jack cuando ocurrió eso? [She said — where was Jack when that happened?]
Joel dijo — en el asiento del conductor, eso fue lo peor [Joel said — in the driver's seat, that was the worst]

[Chorus — English]
Jack got me good, Jack got me good
I didn't see it coming like I thought I would
Broken leg, suspected, maybe the ankle too
Jack got me good — what are you gonna do

[Bridge — Français]
Jack a bien eu Joel, Jack a bien eu Joel [Jack got Joel good, Jack got Joel good]
Je n'ai pas vu ça venir comme j'aurais dû [I didn't see it coming like I should have]
Jambe cassée, soupçonnée, peut-être la cheville aussi [Broken leg, suspected, maybe the ankle too]
Jack a bien eu Joel — qu'est-ce qu'on va faire? [Jack got Joel good — what are we going to do?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas heard about it later that same night
Said — son, a golf buggy's not a bumper car, alright?
Joel said — tell that to Jack, not me
Chas said — That's my boy — and laughed till he couldn't see

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
Jack got me good
Jack me dio bien [Jack got me good]
Jack m'a bien eu [Jack got me good]
That's my boy
